Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Connects this backend to a PostgreSQL server for logical replication and SQL, through PostgreSQL's own
<code>libpqwalreceiver</code>, as the built-in logical replication subscriber connects.

```csharp
public sealed class PgReplicationConnection : IDisposable
```

The connection is a logical replication connection to the database the connection string names, which also runs
ordinary SQL. It belongs to the backend that opened it, outlives transactions, and closes when disposed or when the
backend exits. Waits wake when this backend's latch is set and honor query cancellation. Connection and protocol
failures raise PostgreSQL errors in this backend; a failed command on the server throws
[PgRemoteException](/api/ankus.pgremoteexception/) and leaves this backend's transaction untouched.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

Implements: [IDisposable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.idisposable)

### CopyInto(uint, IReadOnlyList&lt;string&gt;?)

Reads the rows of a <code>COPY ... TO STDOUT</code> started with [StartCopy(string)](/api/ankus.pgreplicationconnection/#member-c48fb8e22933dd30) into a local table, as the
built-in subscriber's table synchronization does.

```csharp
public long CopyInto(uint relationOid, IReadOnlyList<string>? columns = null)
```

Parameters:

`relationOid` — [uint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint32)

The local table's OID.

`columns` — [IReadOnlyList&lt;string&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlylist-1)

The table's columns that receive the copy's columns, in order, or null for all of them.

Returns: [long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int64)

The number of rows copied.

Exceptions:

- [PgException](/api/ankus.pgexception/): A row is rejected, the user lacks the privilege, or the connection failed.

The copy must use COPY's text format. The rows go through PostgreSQL's own <code>COPY FROM</code>, which checks
constraints, fills indexes, routes rows to partitions and fires triggers as <code>session_replication_role</code>
selects. It needs <code>INSERT</code> on the table and, like the built-in subscriber, refuses a table whose row-level
security applies to the user. The connection runs commands again afterward. If the copy fails, the server's copy
is left unfinished, so dispose the connection.

### Query(string, int)

Runs a query and returns its rows as text, as the server formats each value.

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<string?[]> Query(string query, int columns)
```

Parameters:

`query` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The query text, such as <code>SELECT</code>, <code>IDENTIFY_SYSTEM</code> or
            <code>CREATE_REPLICATION_SLOT</code>.

`columns` — [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

The number of columns the query returns; a different number is an error.

Returns: [IReadOnlyList&lt;string[]&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlylist-1)

Each row's values, with null for SQL NULL.

Exceptions:

- [PgRemoteException](/api/ankus.pgremoteexception/): The query failed on the server.
- [PgException](/api/ankus.pgexception/): The query returned another number of columns, or the connection failed.

Rows need a transaction, because PostgreSQL looks up their column types in the catalog; a background worker runs
such queries inside [RunTransaction(Action)](/api/ankus.pgbackgroundworker/#member-cc4c154898bd56ae). Commands without rows, streaming and
copies work outside transactions.

### Receive(TimeSpan, out ReadOnlySpan&lt;byte&gt;)

Receives the next message of a copy, waiting up to <code class="paramref">timeout</code> for one.

Parameters:

`timeout` — [TimeSpan](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.timespan)

`message` — [ReadOnlySpan&lt;byte&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1)

The message, valid until the connection's next call.

Returns: [PgReplicationReceiveStatus](/api/ankus.pgreplicationreceivestatus/)

Whether a message arrived, the wait timed out, the latch woke it, or the copy ended.

### StartCopy(string)

Starts a copy: <code>COPY ... TO STDOUT</code>, whose rows [Receive(TimeSpan, out ReadOnlySpan&lt;byte&gt;)](/api/ankus.pgreplicationconnection/#member-f4e73f05eee48ea1) then returns, or
<code>START_REPLICATION</code>, which streams changes and accepts [Send(ReadOnlySpan&lt;byte&gt;)](/api/ankus.pgreplicationconnection/#member-18051597e3919d58).

```csharp
public void StartCopy(string command)
```

Parameters:

`command` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The command text.

Exceptions:

- [PgRemoteException](/api/ankus.pgremoteexception/): The command failed on the server.
- [PgException](/api/ankus.pgexception/): The command did not start a copy, or the connection failed.
